mcp_catalog_entries:
CREATE TABLE `mcp_catalog_entries` (
  `id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `source_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `scope` enum('ENTERPRISE','ORGANIZATION','PERSONAL') NOT NULL,
  `owner_organization_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `owner_user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `server_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,

  `description` text NOT NULL,

  `featured` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  `runtime` json NOT NULL,
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT `mcp_catalog_exact_owner` CHECK ((((`scope` = _utf8mb4'ENTERPRISE') and (`owner_organization_id` is null) and (`owner_user_id` is null)) or ((`scope` = _utf8mb4'ORGANIZATION') and (`owner_organization_id` is not null) and (`owner_user_id` is null)) or ((`scope` = _utf8mb4'PERSONAL') and (`owner_organization_id` is null) and (`owner_user_id` is not null))))
